newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Anzoil reports oil flow from onshore Vietnam well.
newsitem.headline: Anzoil reports oil flow from onshore Vietnam well.

text.p: Australia's Anzoil NL said on Wednesday that its B10 onshore well in northern Vietnam had tested at an unstable rate of 260 barrels per day of oil (bpd).

A statement from the Adelaide-based firm said the well had been tested over a six-hour period on May 9 and again for an eight-hour period on May 10 when weak flows of gas were recorded and no oil produced.

The company said further testing would be required to establish stable conditions, but added that the equipment to do so was being used for fracture operations scheduled to begin on Wednesday at its D14-3 well.
Anzoil began drilling in northern Vietnam's Hanoi basin last year. The B-10 well is the last in its current three-well exploration programme.
Anzoil's majority-owned Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd is the operator of the production sharing contract covering the basin.
